# Invariants

<!-- GENERATED by `python -m workflow.core.emitter.invariants` — do not edit by hand. -->

Every constraint the framework enforces, with the layer that enforces it and
the principle it derives from. This is generated from the invariant registry
(`workflow/core/invariants.py`); see [ADR-0004](adr/0004-invariant-registry-and-guard-placement.md)
for the guard-placement principle and [state-machine-principles.md](state-machine-principles.md)
for the design rationale.

An invariant lives in the layer that has the information to check it:

- **parser** — Shape and single-artifact rules — checked at parse time (`ParseError`).
- **validator** — Cross-artifact and whole-graph rules — checked by `validate-workflow` (`ValidationFinding`; the only layer that may emit a WARNING).
- **planner** — Live-issue marker preconditions — checked at operation time (`OperationError`).

## Validator invariants

| ID | Severity | Statement | Principle | Enforced by |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `AGENT_PREPARES_PRESENT` | WARNING | Every catalogued gate points at an agent-prepares template. | `hitl-principles.md#8` | `_check_agent_prepares_present` |
| `AUDIT_NOT_ON_IRREVERSIBLE` | ERROR | Audit-level gating is forbidden on transitions into irreversible destinations. | `hitl-principles.md#4` | `_check_audit_irreversible` |
| `BLOCK_ON_TIMEOUT_VALID` | ERROR | A block-level gate's on_timeout is one of the allowed actions (abort / escalate). | `hitl-principles.md#4` | `_check_block_on_timeout` |
| `CLOSES_EXCLUSIVITY` | ERROR | `closes` is mutually exclusive with is_initial / collects / handoff / issue_types and forbids spawns.advance_on. | `state-machine-principles.md#1` | `_check_closes_exclusivity` |
| `CLOSING_STATES_ARE_SINKS` | ERROR | A closing state (carrying `closes`) has no outgoing transitions. | `state-machine-principles.md#1` | `_check_closing_states_are_sinks` |
| `COLLECTS_VALID` | ERROR | Collect rules sit on a resting state, resolve their source process/states/types, and keep advance_on and release_on disjoint. | `state-machine-principles.md#9` | `_check_collects` |
| `ENTRY_NOT_ALSO_TARGET` | ERROR | An is_initial state is not also a collects target or a spawn target — one entry path per state. | `state-machine-principles.md#2` | `_check_entry_not_also_target` |
| `GATES_HAVE_UNIQUE_SOURCE` | ERROR | A gate fires from exactly one source state (verdict-style gates share a source, differing only by destination). | `hitl-principles.md#6` | `_check_gates_have_unique_source` |
| `HANDOFFS_HAVE_PARTNERS` | ERROR | Every handoff state is declared by at least one other process. | `state-machine-principles.md#9` | `_check_handoffs_have_partners` |
| `HUMAN_INPUTS_RESOLVED` | ERROR | Every human-input topic referenced on a working state resolves in human-inputs.json (a missing directory is a warning). | `hitl-principles.md#7` | `_check_human_inputs_resolved` |
| `IRREVERSIBLE_DESTINATIONS_GATED` | WARNING | Every transition into an irreversible destination carries a human gate. | `state-machine-principles.md#11` | `_check_irreversible_destinations_gated` |
| `ISSUE_TYPES_RESOLVED` | ERROR | Every issue-type id referenced on a state resolves in issue-types.json (a missing directory is a warning). | `state-machine-principles.md#1` | `_check_issue_types_resolved` |
| `LEGEND_CATALOG_SYNC` | WARNING | Diagram gate markers, the legend, and the human-gate catalog agree. | `hitl-principles.md#5` | `_check_legend_catalog_sync` |
| `LEVEL_KEYWORDS_NOT_ON_DIAGRAM` | WARNING | State notes don't carry standalone block/audit level keywords (level is a runtime / trust-grant property). | `state-machine-principles.md#11` | `_check_level_keywords_not_on_diagram` |
| `PROCESS_REACHABLE` | WARNING | Every process has at least one entry: an is_initial state, a collects declaration, an inbound spawn, or a shared handoff. | `state-machine-principles.md#2` | `_check_process_reachable` |
| `REVERSIBILITY_DECLARED_ON_LEGEND_STATES` | WARNING | Every gated transition's destination state declares a reversibility class. | `hitl-principles.md#4` | `_check_reversibility_declared_on_legend_states` |
| `SPAWNS_VALID` | ERROR | Spawn rules resolve to a real target process/state, accept the spawned type, agree on the parent-advance target, and key advance_on on closing states. | `state-machine-principles.md#9` | `_check_spawns` |
| `STATE_NAMES_UNIQUE` | ERROR | A state name shared across processes is marked handoff in all of them; other duplicates are forbidden. | `state-machine-principles.md#9` | `_check_duplicate_state_names` |
| `TRANSITION_TYPE_COMPATIBILITY` | ERROR | Transition source/destination state classes match the transition type (claim resting→working, role-action working→resting, event resting→resting). | `state-machine-principles.md#2` | `_check_transition_type_compatibility` |
| `TRUST_GRANTS_VALID` | ERROR | Trust grants are unexpired, target an allowed level, carry evidence, and never set audit on an irreversible destination. | `trust-grant-schema.md#7` | `_check_trust_grants` |
| `WORKING_STATES_ARE_CLAIM_DESTINATIONS` | ERROR | Every working state has at least one incoming CLAIM transition. | `state-machine-principles.md#3` | `_check_working_states_are_claim_destinations` |
